lead_headline: OpenCode reports breach affecting some Console users
facebook_post:
OpenCode reports breach affecting some Console users

OpenCode says 1.4% of its Console users were affected, specifically those with external providers linked. If you received a breach notice, revoke linked provider keys and check usage. The wider scope is still being investigated.
